# agent-auth

> Scoped, expiring, auditable credentials for AI agents that act on a user's behalf. A self-hosted service, TypeScript SDK and CLI. Apache-2.0.

## Docs

- [Quickstart](https://superintelligenceco.github.io/agent-auth/quickstart): run the server and issue, check, attenuate and revoke a token
- [Concepts](https://superintelligenceco.github.io/agent-auth/concepts): principals, agents, scopes, attenuation, revocation, audit log
- [Use it from a tool server](https://superintelligenceco.github.io/agent-auth/tool-servers): verifying tokens in an MCP or HTTP tool server
- [Architecture](https://superintelligenceco.github.io/agent-auth/architecture)
- [CLI reference](https://superintelligenceco.github.io/agent-auth/reference/cli)
- [REST API reference](https://superintelligenceco.github.io/agent-auth/reference/api)
- [FAQ](https://superintelligenceco.github.io/agent-auth/faq)

## Source

- [README](https://github.com/superintelligenceco/agent-auth/blob/main/README.md)
- [OpenAPI description](https://github.com/superintelligenceco/agent-auth/blob/main/openapi.yaml)
- [Changelog](https://github.com/superintelligenceco/agent-auth/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md)

## Install

- npm: `npm install @superintelligenceco/agent-auth`
- Image: `ghcr.io/superintelligenceco/agent-auth`
- Executables and `install.sh`: https://github.com/superintelligenceco/agent-auth/releases
